# Continental Divide Trail Coalition

> > The Continental Divide Trail Coalition (CDTC) is the nonprofit organization dedicated to completing, promoting, and protecting the Continental Divide National Scenic Trail across Montana, Idaho, Wyoming, Colorado, and New Mexico.

The CDTC works on trail stewardship, publishes the Passages newsletter, and provides hiking resources for the 3,100-mile Continental Divide Trail. The organization coordinates trail maintenance, reroute projects, and community engagement across five western states.

## Key Topics

- Continental Divide Trail (CDT)
- Trail stewardship and maintenance
- Montana, Idaho, Wyoming, Colorado, New Mexico
- Day hiking and trail sections
- Passages newsletter
- Trail reroute projects
- Gila Wilderness
- Bridger Wilderness
- Cibola National Forest
- Mt. Taylor (Tsoodził)
- Public lands conservation
- Thru-hiking resources
- Volunteer trail work
- National Scenic Trail system

## Trail News & Publications

- [Passages: August 2021](https://cdtcoalition.org/publication/passages-august-2021): August 2021 issue of Passages newsletter covering CDT news and updates
- [Passages: December 2020](https://cdtcoalition.org/publication/passages-december-2020): December 2020 Passages newsletter featuring CDT updates and stories
- [Passages: February 2017](https://cdtcoalition.org/publication/passages-february-2017): February 2017 Passages newsletter with CDT Coalition news and updates
- [Digging In | Completing the Neglected Mine Trail Reroute](https://cdtcoalition.org/neglected-mine-reroute): Trail reconstruction project in Gila Wilderness, New Mexico by CDTC

## Hiking Suggestions & Trail Sections

- [Tsoodził (Mt. Taylor), Cibola National Forest](https://cdtcoalition.org/hike_suggestion/tsoodzil-mt-taylor-cibola-national-forest): 6.2-mile moderate-difficult hike at Mt. Taylor, Cibola National Forest, NM
- [Island Lake Loop, Bridger Wilderness](https://cdtcoalition.org/hike_suggestion/island-lake-loop-bridger-wilderness): Island Lake Loop day hike in Bridger Wilderness, Wyoming near CDT
- [MacDonald Pass to Tenmile Creek via Switchback Ridge](https://cdtcoalition.org/hike_suggestion/macdonald-pass-to-tenmile-creek-via-switchback-ridge): Montana CDT section hike: MacDonald Pass to Tenmile Creek via ridgeline
- [Zuni-Acoma and Chain of Craters, El Malpais National Monument](https://cdtcoalition.org/hike_suggestion/zuni-acoma-and-chain-of-craters-el-malpais-national-monument): Day hike at El Malpais National Monument in New Mexico's high desert
